units.summary: Adds a comment above the existing len(m.String()) call in Size() explaining that String() is used on purpose so Size() does not mutate the Quantity. The code is unchanged. Because String() no longer caches elsewhere in this PR, the comment matches how the code now behaves.
units.headline: Comment added explaining Size() avoids caching the string
units.reason: Comment-only diff; the executable line len(m.String()) is untouched, so behavior cannot change.

units.summary: New test builds a Quantity with no cached string, calls Size(), and checks that q.s is still empty. It covers the new rule that Size() must not mutate the receiver. It only adds coverage and does not touch production code.
units.headline: New test checks Size() leaves the cached string unset
units.reason: New test-only code that cannot affect production behavior; it adds a guard on the no-mutation behavior.
